# Full n9 local relation span

**PROVED (preserved geometric inputs), COMPUTATIONALLY-VERIFIED (exact finite matrix).** Let U9 be the free rational vector space on the 942 all-Z admissible tile source labels, and let L9 be generated by every nonzero one-parent relation in the complete Run 4 local-parent theorem, transported to nine labels. The complete matrix has 693 distinct rows and

\[
\dim_{\mathbb Q}L_9=470,\qquad \dim_{\mathbb Q}(U_9/L_9)=472.
\]

The [machine matrix](../../results/run6/local_relation_matrix_n9.json) stores the dense integer rows, lexicographic affine column order, every labeled parent, every admissible facet, all retained transport origins, a rational row basis, pivot columns and an exact nonzero minor. The [tile inventory](../../results/run6/tile_universe_n9.json) supplies the complete column certificates.

## Full parent coverage

Each Run 4 prototype of support size at most nine is transported by every dihedral action and every increasing support insertion. Rows are identified up to one common sign, retaining every origin. Exactly 1044 prototype transports produce 693 distinct rows, each associated with exactly one labeled parent.

| Parent nonloop support | Balanced parents / rows | Collapsed parents | Hostile zero-kernel parents |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 7 | 252 | 0 | 0 |
| 8 | 360 | 72 | 72 |
| 9 | 81 | 36 | 9 |
| Total | 693 | 108 | 81 |

All 882 dimension-nine rank-two parents occur. The independent bounded-affine enumeration checks this completeness. For every parent, an independent full-basis inclusion test against all 942 admissible tile labels recovers exactly its recorded admissible facets. Each balanced parent's row contains exactly those facets, with the signs already geometrically certified in Run 4. Collapsed and hostile parents have zero admissible-facet relation kernel by that theorem and contribute no row.

Of the 693 rows, 594 are six-term 3-to-3 relations and 99 are ten-term 5-to-5 relations. Their coefficient sums are all zero; all 942 columns participate. This is the complete Run 4 one-parent matrix at n9, including supports seven, eight and nine. It is not a restriction to embedded seven-label moves.

## Exact rank certificate

**COMPUTATIONALLY-VERIFIED with independently checkable exact certificates.** Sparse rational RREF selects 470 independent original rows and 470 pivot columns. The corresponding 470-by-470 integer minor has determinant **−1**. Its nonvanishing proves the lower rank bound; a modular check gives 1000002 modulo 1000003.

The stored 470 nonzero reduced rows have 4522 nonzero entries, all integers. Their pivot-column submatrix is the identity. If B is this reduced matrix and J is its pivot-column list, every original row satisfies the exact factorization

\[
M=M_{[:,J]}B.
\]

The factorization proves the upper rank bound 470. Independent Fraction arithmetic verifies every row equality and computes the integer minor determinant −1 without calling the producer's SymPy routines. Independent direct basis transformations also check all 1044 retained transport origins.

The producer is [run6_local_span.py](../../src/magic_number/run6_local_span.py), function `build_local_matrix()`. The independent checks are in [test_run6_local_span.py](../../tests/test_run6_local_span.py).

## Scope of the conclusion

The Run 4 all-Z image-relation theorem gives L9 contained in the all-Z indicator kernel, and zero coefficient sum on L9. The rank calculation itself does not establish the reverse inclusion, actual tiling-difference generation or connectivity of complete tilings. The quotient dimension 472 is the target for the separate complete-indicator certificate; it must not be treated as a proved indicator rank merely from this matrix.

Likewise, an integer sum of local rows is not necessarily an ordered sequence of legal flips. Actual flip ancestry, if obtained in the bounded Run 6 search, is recorded separately in N9_GENERATION.md. No complete n9 tiling enumeration is attempted here.

## The loopless block and a signed conservation law

**COMPUTATIONALLY-VERIFIED.** The restriction of all 693 local rows to the 30 loopless tile columns has rank 29. A recorded 29-by-29 minor has determinant −1. Its one-dimensional nullspace is generated by the vector assigning +1 to the 27 loopless BCFW cells and −1 to the three spurions. Extending this vector by zero on the other 912 columns annihilates every local relation.

Consequently the image of the support-at-most-eight tile subspace in U9/L9 has dimension

\[
912-(470-29)=471,
\]

and the loopless sector adds exactly one quotient dimension. The raw number of loopless pieces is not conserved: 18 local rows have nonzero raw loopless coefficient sum of absolute value two. With the stored lexicographic row sign convention, eight have +2 and ten have −2. The signed difference between loopless BCFW pieces and spurions is conserved.

The standard 50-piece BCFW tiling has signed weight two. **Conditional here on the separately proved full indicator-kernel equality K9=L9**, every complete all-Z tiling therefore satisfies

\[
\#\{\text{loopless BCFW tiles}\}-\#\{\text{spurion tiles}\}=2.
\]

The [support-block certificate](../../results/run6/support_blocks.json) stores the projected matrix, minor, covector, every relation evaluation, raw-count failures and base weight. The sixth independent matrix test checks the determinant and every annihilation exactly. This file's local calculation alone proves conservation under local relations, while extension to arbitrary complete tilings requires the separate kernel theorem.
